resources.string: The road to Still Creek. Now on Android.
Bring your own Xbox 360 copy. No game data is included. Device gameplay is not yet verified.
DIAGNOSTICS BUILD — contains stub guest code. This APK cannot play the game.
Your copy is not installed yet.
Game files verified. Ready for first-run preparation.
Case Zero XBLA package (title 58410A8D), or a folder/ZIP with default.xex and data/. ISOs, PC copies and mods are not supported.
Defaults: 720p, 30 FPS, low shadows, no MSAA or ray tracing. Higher settings may exceed mobile GPU memory.
System driver by default. No bundled Turnip binary. Imported drivers are untrusted native code: use only a source you trust. Mali and Xclipse use the system driver.
A graphics driver executes native code with access to your app data. Continue only if you trust the provider.
Previous custom-driver startup failed. Switched back to System; your imported driver is kept.
Hide when using a physical controller
Bluetooth / USB gamepads work through SDL. A, B, X, Y, shoulders, triggers, sticks, D-pad, Start and Back are available on screen.
Drag controls to move them. Layout uses screen-relative coordinates.
Replace current saves with this backup? Export a backup first. Game files and graphics settings will not be changed.
Shaders will be rebuilt from your game data on the next launch. Saves will not be touched.
Data stays in app-private storage across APK updates, but Android removes it on uninstall. Export saves before uninstalling. Files access is read-only to protect a running game.
A transfer or game session is active. Finish it first.
Working… Keep the app open until complete.
Cancelled. Your previous installation is unchanged.
Unsaved progress will be lost. Save in the game first.
No newer compatible APK was found.
Verified APK. Continue in the Android installer.
Allow this app to install updates in Android settings, then try again.
Native libraries could not be loaded. Install the complete arm64-v8a APK.
Import a compatible ARM64 driver first.
Touch controls are off. Connect a controller before playing.
Updates are disabled for diagnostic builds. Use a game APK signed with the same release key.
Optional: grant Nearby devices before launching to use SDL’s Steam Controller BLE support. Ordinary Android gamepads and touch do not need this permission.
